Comment by: Shandana Khan

@Kiran Vadday I’m not sure the intoduced in version is correct here - it’s set to a release from October last year. If the intention was to set it to Secure October 2026 Release 1/2, I’m not sure that’s correct either, as that’s not due for another few weeks. Please be aware, this field is used to indicate when this bug was introduced, not when it is due to be fixed. Guidance was provided 10/09 to Leads around how to set this - it may not have been passed along though -please use the skill /analyze-ticket to get this info.
